summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）扩散模型应用年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Dpm-solver in the Diffusion Model Application area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Dpm-solver: A fast ode solver for diffusion probabilistic model sampling in around 10 steps”. The page names Cheng Lu, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
